note: Campground on 25 acres off Kelly Rd near Henderson (Vance Co), about 8 miles from Kerr Lake; fishing ponds, walking trail, dog park, rent-a-tents and cottages. Google 4.8 over 28 reviews (2026-10-01). --Claude
summary: Confirmed fees $30 (dry RV site) to $55 (pull-thru) from the operator's rates page, pull-throughs. Added 50-amp electric and water, showers, laundry, camp store, dump station, phone booking with one-night deposit. Sewer not stated for nightly sites (only the monthly class lists it). Base $30 is under the US$50 gate; presence via the operator's own website with a phone. Transient in character (nightly rates, events, rallies); month-to-month offered by quote only.
